# Golden Horse Award for Best Live Action Short Film

}}
The Golden Horse Award for Best Live Action Short Film () is presented annually at Taiwan's Golden Horse Film Awards. The latest ceremony was held on November 22, 2025, with Hu Lu winning the award for Pile On.
